profile.name: 350型多通道温度控制器
profile.description: 一款多通道温度控制器，可读取多个温度传感器输入并驱动加热器输出，用于温度设定值保持、按斜坡升降温以及加热功率调节，常用于实验中的样品温度监测与稳定控制。
profile.description_en: A multi-channel temperature controller that reads multiple temperature sensor inputs and drives heater outputs for setpoint regulation, ramped temperature changes, and heater power control. It is commonly used for sample temperature monitoring and stabilization in laboratory experiments.
